ITriggerScript.title: script trigger
ITriggerScript.scriptMode_simple: Simple mode (just modify the check() function)
ITriggerScript.modeDescription_simple: Simple mode: The framework handles the lifecycle automatically. You only need to implement the conditional judgment logic in the provided check() function. When the condition is met, call that.dispatchConditionsOn(), otherwise call that.dispatchConditionsOff().
ITriggerScript.modeDescription_advanced: Advanced mode: You get the complete attach function and can fully customize all logic. Suitable for handling complex life cycle management and event monitoring.
ITriggerScript.modeDescription_full: Complete mode: Provides sample code including registration, export, and complete life cycle. Can be used directly as a standalone script.
